status: Research only; never a recommendation or production probability
primary_gate: At least 1000 settled player-games and 60 games; paired Brier improvement >=0.001 against frozen production and Beta(1,1) frequency, game/player clustered upper95% delta<0, nonworsening logloss. No retuning or early promotion.
settlement: Official scorer TD including rush, receiving, special teams, defense and fumble recovery; passing TD alone excluded. Nonparticipants/inactives void; unknown outcomes pending. Book settlement requires separately verified terms.
market_benchmark: Not captured in v1. No sportsbook edge claim; matched two-sided pregame prices required for a separate benchmark.
capture_policy: Complete weekly slate before its first kickoff; current-season current-team prior offensive appearances, completed kickoff+12h, fresh active availability. No backfill or replacement.
